note: The colour version of the See3CAM_37CUGM (the page title says "Color"; the kit and datasheet links name See3CAM_37CUG). FOV 111 (D) x 89 (H) x 65 (V) degrees "@ 2064 x 1552 Resolution" (the page does not say with which lens; the M12 holder is fitted with a lens in the kit). The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the maker states no projection or distortion coefficients; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. Frame rate "3MP @51 fps", UYVY output; the page does not give the stream size of the "3MP" mode, so no stream is entered. Power "TBD" and weight "TBD": power_w and mass_g are null (not stated); size_mm is null (only "l x b" 30 x 30 mm). Not stated: f-number, focal length, distortion. FOV consistency: the maker's angles disagree with the lens geometry by up to 2.85°: on the 2064 × 1552 image a centred lens without pincushion distortion keeps the diagonal angle (111°) at most the vertical angle × diagonal / H (108.2°). That is within the makers' stated FOV tolerance of about ±3° and their rounding (validation check library.fov_shape), so the angles are kept as stated.
